role: A recording downloaded from strap memory with its own start time (and clock re-basing onto a session), plus the persisted ledger of recording starts already downloaded.
types: StrapDownloadLedger: struct — UserDefaults-backed set of downloaded recording starts (capacity 60) and the date the ledger began
state: ud:strapDownloadedRecordingStarts ([Double] whole-second epoch starts, standard suite)

units.does: startedAt plus the end offset of the last beat (endOffsetMs: its wallClockMs, else t_ms, plus its interval), so an optical recording's rejected intervals count as elapsed time; nil without a start.

Milliseconds from the recording start to the end of its last beat: the last point's wallClockMs (real time, carried by optical recordings) or else t_ms, plus its rr_ms; 0 for no points. For an H10 recording (no wall clock, no gaps) this equals the summed beat duration.

Returns the points re-based onto a session starting at sessionStart: shifted later by (recording start − session start) when the recording started after the session; unchanged when it started before or no start is known.
units.entry: Called from RRCollector+BackupRecovery.swift:167,393, RRCollector+DeviceRecording.swift:124, RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift:493, WorkoutRecorder+DeviceBackup.swift:188.

branches.effect: nil: points returned unshifted; else use startedAt, falling back to fallbackStart when startedAt is nil
false: unshifted (recording began at/before the session, or offset fallback 0); true: every point shifted by offsetMs
